name: Health
description: Health (also known as health points, hit points, or HP) is one of three Vitals in Outward, represented by the red circular bar in the bottom left corner of screen.
mechanics: 10% of damage taken in combat is lost as burnt health
Burnt health cannot be healed until rested
Maximum health can be permanently increased/decreased through Leyline in Conflux Chambers
Skills can increase maximum health

name: Stamina
description: Stamina is one of three Vitals in Outward, represented by the green circular bar. It is consumed by physically-demanding activities.
mechanics: 3% of consumed stamina is lost as burnt stamina
Burnt stamina regenerates slowly over time
Sprinting costs 2 stamina per second
Dodging costs 6 stamina
Blocking costs stamina based on damage blocked

name: Mana
description: Mana is one of three Vitals in Outward, represented by the blue circular bar. It is used by magic to cast spells and magic-based skills.
mechanics: Characters do not start with Mana
Obtained through Ley Line (sacrifice Health/Stamina)
Sleeping burns 5% of max mana per hour (max 50% burnt)
Casting spells restores burnt mana
Mana Cost modifier capped at -99%, minimum 1 mana per spell
acquisition: Ley Line in Conflux Chambers (sacrifice 25 Health or Stamina for 5 Mana)

name: Fire Resistance
description: Reduces Fire damage taken. One of six elemental damage types.
mechanics: Percentage reduction of Fire damage
Can be gained from Equipment, Skills, Effects, Potions

name: Frost Resistance
description: Reduces Frost damage taken. One of six elemental damage types.
mechanics: Percentage reduction of Frost damage
Can be gained from Equipment, Skills, Effects, Potions

name: Hot Weather Defense
description: Protects against hot weather effects. Stacks with Cold Weather Defense.

name: Cold Weather Defense
description: Protects against cold weather effects. Stacks with Hot Weather Defense.

name: Stealth
description: Determines how easily the player can be detected by enemies. Affected by crouching, armor weight, and skills.
mechanics: Crouching increases stealth
Heavy armor decreases stealth
Some skills and effects modify stealth

name: Corruption
description: Attribute and gameplay mechanic in The Soroboreans DLC and Definitive Edition. Ranges from 0 to 100%.

levels.name: Defiled
levels.effects: Severe negative effects, 45 Raw damage at 100%
